description: Use to compare unemployment in Poland with EU countries, also youth unemployment. For registered unemployment in Polish voivodeships, use get_regional_data. Monthly unemployment rate in the 27 EU countries, the EU and the euro area from Eurostat (une_rt_m, seasonally adjusted, ILO definition from labour force surveys): total and persons under 25, rank from the lowest rate, change vs the previous month and a year earlier in percentage points, rank of Poland in every month since 2010, history of Poland, the EU, the euro area and one comparison country, and the finwire index finwire_eu_youth_unemployment_ratio (youth rate divided by the total rate in Poland). This is not the registered unemployment rate of Polish labour offices (GUS); for that and for voivodeships use get_regional_data with topic unemployment.

compare.description: EU country code (Eurostat or ISO, Greece = EL or GR) to compare with Poland, default DE.

history.description: Number of past months in the summary, default 12.

name: get_eu_unemployment
title: Unemployment in EU countries (Eurostat)
